profile.headline: Senior Staff Software Engineer at Meta AI
profile.jobTitle: Sr. Staff Software Engineer, Meta AI
profile.summary:
Experienced AI/ML Tech Lead and Manager with a proven track record of delivering best-in-class AI solutions for Meta (Facebook/Instagram/Ads), Amazon (Alexa/Ring), and Qualcomm. Skilled in leading complex projects from concept to launch, including defining requirements and roadmaps, system design, prototyping, and quality assurance through close coordination of diverse engineering and cross-functional teams.

Technical Specialties: deep learning modeling (LLM/VLM, ranking, CV detection & recognition, ASR, wakeword, denoising), model optimization (compression/quantization, kernel/graph optimization, NAS/AutoML), software architecture (ML compiler, training & inference engine) and HW acceleration (GPU/NPU/CPU/DSP).

Top ranked in AI/ML competitions (#1 in CVPR visual wake words, #3 in NeurIPS micronet). Received best and outstanding papers (MLSys, MDM) and best demo awards (SECON). Published 30+ research papers on top conferences in various fields (MLSys, SenSys, MobiSys, ICASSP) and granted 30+ US patents (2600+ citations)

positions.title: Sr. Staff Software Engineer, Meta AI
positions.description:
Uber TL. Build SOTA AI models, systems and personal ai agent for next-gen AI devices like smart glass, which can understand physical world

Built best-in-class LLM/VLM/RecSys models & efficient large-scale GPU training and serving for Facebook, Instagram and Ads
positions.insights: Skills: Large Language Models (LLM) · Agentic AI Development

positions.title: Principal Applied Scientist, Amazon Device AI
positions.description: Tech lead in Amazon Device AI. Led key CV/ML feature launches for Amazon Devices (Alexa Echo, Ring) including data collection, camera tuning, model training, and quantization for NPU along with cool but confidential R&D projects

positions.title: Sr. Staff Engineer, Qualcomm AI Research
positions.description:
Qualcomm AI Research (Nov 2017 - May 2020)
• Led deep learning complier team (#1 CVPR'19 Visual Wake Words Challenge)
• Led model compression/quantization team (#3 NeurIPS'19 Micronet Challenge)
• Developed on-device ASR/VoiceUI and Wakewod detection models
• Developed reinforcement learning-based Qualcomm SoC optimization

Qualcomm Research (May 2014 - Oct 2017)
• Developed CNN/RNN-based speech denoising model for hearing aid
• Led pilot projects on healthcare (e.g., elderly monitoring, fall detection)
• Developed ultra low-power machine learning algorithms for mobile phones
• Developed motion-aware WiFi and GPS algorithms for energy efficiency

Corporate R&D (2010 - Apr 2014)
• Mobile Sensing and Context-awareness (location, activity, sensor fusion)
• Sensor-based calorie expenditure estimation for fitness applications
• Ultrasound-based proximity detection (QTech paper top ranked)
• WiFi and GPS-based automatic place discovery and recognition
